subject: help with housing stability aging in place home modifications

subject: Shut down the decorated house on 900 E
comment: There's a house on 900 E near Bryan Avenue that is constantly over decorated for Halloween every year. Every year cars slam on their brakes in front of their house and almost cause accidents. I can't tell you how often I hear cars honking because someone slammed on their brakes to look at that house. Furthermore, it's incredibly dangerous for pedestrians. There's a crosswalk there with a light that people constantly ignore because they're staring at the house instead of driving safely. Tonight someone almost hit me and my dog while we were walking. It's really exhausting for people in the neighborhood to worry about their safety because of this vanity project. Would be great to see the city do something about it for once.
